name: Tahini-Cardamom Oatmeal with Oranges, Dates, Sesame Seeds & Honey
instructions: Place water and salt in a medium saucepan, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Once boiling, stir in oats, honey, and cardamom. Cover and let simmer, on low, 3-5 minutes, or until oats reach desired consistency.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and peel oranges; separate into segments and roughly chop the flesh.
When the oatmeal is done, add tahini to the saucepan and stir to combine. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide oatmeal between bowls; top with oranges, dates, and sesame seeds. Drizzle with honey and enjoy!
author: Mealime
